Criteria for Approval:
• Diagnosis of one of the following conditions:
o Open-angle glaucoma, OR
o Ocular hypertension; AND
• Patient has had ≥ 30-day trial and failure, allergy,
contraindication (including potential drug-drug interactions with
other medications) or intolerance to ≥ 2 preferred agents any
sub-class.

Approval Duration: 3 months initial; 1 year renewal

• Diagnosis of presbyopia; AND
• Prescribed by, or in consultation with, an ophthalmologist or
optometrist; AND
• Prescriber has provided documentation of trial and failure,
contraindication, or clinically significant adverse effects of

corrective eyeglasses or contact lenses to resolve symptoms;
AND

• Patient has had ≥ 30-day trial and failure, allergy,
contraindication (including potential drug-drug interactions with
other medications), or intolerance to ≥ 2 preferred agents for
this FDA-approved indication (if available and covered).

• Prescriber attestation of clinically significant improvement or
stabilization in clinical signs and symptoms.

Age Limit: ≥ 40 years
Quantity Limit: 1 bottle (2.5 mL) per month
